newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS SIGNS NBA VETERAN BYRON SCOTT.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS SIGNS NBA VETERAN BYRON SCOTT.

text.p: Former European basketball champions Panathinaikos signed on Thursday veteran NBA player Byron Scott in an effort to revamp the club's fortunes after a bad season.
Panathinaikos officials said they paid $1.5 million to sign the 1.93-metre forward who last played for Vancouver.
Scott, 36, has won three NBA titles with the Los Angeles Lakers in 1985, 1987 and 1988 and has played more than 1,200 matches in the NBA.
Panathinaikos, the most expensive club in Europe, won the Euroleague championship in 1996 led by NBA star Dominique Wilkins.
But this year they only managed to win participation in the Korac Cup.
